display_long_description:
Birds VS Birds V7 is a fast-paced VR game where you jump into the sky and battle other birds in chaotic aerial combat. You control your movement using VR motion, letting you fly, dive, dodge, and chase enemies through the air. Every match is focused on quick reactions, smart movement, and staying aware of everything happening around you while other birds try to take you down.

As you fly around the map, you’ll fight against other players using different attacks and abilities. Timing your moves and positioning yourself correctly is important, because being caught off guard can quickly turn the fight against you. You can dodge incoming attacks, rush enemies, or escape to reposition before diving back into the fight. The combat is simple to understand but becomes intense as more birds join the battle.

The game is built around constant action, where you’re always moving and reacting. Flying smoothly, controlling your speed, and learning how to maneuver through the air gives you a big advantage over other players. Matches can quickly become chaotic as multiple birds clash in the same space, creating fast and unpredictable fights where anything can happen.
